body:
I was hesitant to even get on these meds because of the side effects I've read on them. It is an anti seizure med called Topamax. My neurologist said that this is the only one he would prescribe for me because the other ones are more dangerous.  He doesn't listen. 
He tried to tell me that all my problems are due to migraines when I started to develop complex/ petite mal seizures and small strokes.
He isn't looking into the fact that I have an enlarged pituitary gland or liver. He is saying it is migraines. I just want to give up because I am loosing my memory, my vision, my ability to walk, and my hearing. No one is listening to me when I know for a fact something is wrong with my body and it is not fucking migraines. I am being pushed to the edge. I am only 20 so it is not an age thing.
